test_title: PYST 22: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 09 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.**

During lockdown, the government and NGOs tried their best to look after people who were __destitute.__
solution:
The correct answer is: **impoverished**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Destitute **means extremely poor; lacking the means to provide for oneself. (निःसहाय)

 
 
• **Example**: *After losing his job and with no savings, he found himself destitute, unable to afford even basic necessities like food and shelter.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Impoverished **means extremely poor, deprived of resources or means. (गरीब)
 
 
• **Example**: *The village, once thriving, had become impoverished after the drought destroyed their crops and depleted their livestock.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Elite**: A select group that is superior in terms of ability, wealth, or social status. (अभिजात वर्ग)
 
• **Haughty**: Someone who is arrogantly superior and disdainful. (घमंडी)
 
• **Patriotic**: Having or expressing devotion and love for one's country. (देशभक्तिपूर्ण)
